question: What should the canonical staged model migration workflow own across staging, verification, promotion, fallback ordering, and rollback?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the command UX and persistence/probe contracts affect provider routing, auth profiles, fallback behavior, diagnostics, and config recovery.

options.title: Design Unified Migration Workflow
options.body: Specify one openclaw models flow that owns staging, verification, promotion, old-primary preservation, rollback state, and interaction with fallback-chain and all-model probes.

options.title: Split Diagnostics First
options.body: Keep this issue as the staged-migration tracker while landing fallback-chain and all-configured-model probes as separate prerequisite diagnostics.

options.title: Defer Built-In Staging
options.body: Keep current immediate-set and manual-fallback primitives and document a safer manual rollout until maintainers want a broader migration contract.

recommendation.title: Design Unified Migration Workflow
recommendation.body: Specify one openclaw models flow that owns staging, verification, promotion, old-primary preservation, rollback state, and interaction with fallback-chain and all-model probes.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the clearest issue guidance and has the strongest history across the model CLI, fallback, and probe surfaces.
